allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 3000,3001,3002 } | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Port=$_.LocalPort; PID=$_.OwningProcess; Name=$p.ProcessName } })

PowerShell(taskkill /PID 37200 /T /F 2>&1; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $still = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq 3000 }; if \($still\) { "PORT 3000 STILL IN USE" } else { "PORT 3000 FREE" })
